title: D-024 Amendment 3 unit C: native runtime adapter (feature detection, background-session dispatch, agents --json ingestion, exactly one active backend)
objective: Build the bounded native-runtime adapter per D-024-R172/R153 and the accepted M0-T102 matrix (background-session-host, structured-passive-observation, worktree-isolation areas): feature detection; named + deterministic session identity (--name; --session-id valid UUID); native background dispatch (claude --bg / --agent); claude agents --json status ingestion for Codex-side passive observation OUTSIDE Fable context; attach/logs/stop/respawn + daemon-status handling incl. supervisor-restart semantics (R032); existing controller dispatch as the feature-detected fallback; exactly ONE selected runtime backend per session, never two process-management systems. G5 unit-C security preconditions: no inbound port; no auto Remote Control; deterministic names carry no hostname/secret; masked fixtures. Worktree baseRef pinned to 'head' or explicit reset (default-branch hazard). Real low-risk canaries on the upgraded 2.1.246 binary; replace-not-layer R180 (parity + failure tests before any custom host path is deprecated in a separate reviewed change). Probe fixtures stamp the consuming task id (G3 ADV-1). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R153 + D-024-R172.
business_reason: Amendment 3 (source-003): reuse the proven native background-session host as producer host with durable custom control retained; adapter is the single bounded seam (R145/R180).
outputs: native runtime adapter modules under tools/agent_supervisor (feature detection, dispatch, agents --json ingestion, attach/logs/stop/respawn, one-backend selection)
tools/test_agent_supervisor_native_adapter.py (dispatch/status/completion/blocked-input/failure/stop/respawn, supervisor-restart no-duplicate, unexpected exit, fallback selection)
